description: State Highway Network Odometer is a dataset listed in Caltrans GIS Data hub, an open geospatial data hub of a state transportation department, published or maintained by Caltrans. The Odometer dataset is used to support accurate distance-based referencing along the State Highway Network. It helps users compare postmile values with actual route mileage, identify mileage changes caused by realignments, and support LRS-based mapping, querying, event placement, and data quality review. Coverage: California, United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Caltrans. Its keywords are Transportation, Odometer, Linear Referencing System, LRS, Roads and Highways, Routes, Measures, State Highway. The bounding box given is -124.2606,32.4629,-113.5394,41.9690. The hub shows 2025-06-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public. Please do not redistribute this dataset. Refer requestors back to Caltrans.. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-caltrans-gis-data-hub.
